entries.title: The speaker portal holds the file limit
entries.summary: once a session is at its file limit, another brand-new file is refused, including when an event admin is using the portal. A new version of a file already on the session is still allowed. The Files tab in the event admin app is not held to that limit.

entries.title: Automation emails can go to one session role
entries.summary: a session automation's **Send to** is the same role list as Send on the Sessions list. Pick submitters, all participants, speakers, primary speakers, chairs, moderators, or a custom role, and combine more than one. Automations saved before this change keep their previous recipients until you change **Send to**.

entries.title: Visit consent can be a contact-only form
entries.summary: the consent picker includes a form or task assigned to one contact, not only ones assigned to a portal. A Visit checkbox can also map to a Sessionboard multi-select, and the values sync both ways.

entries.title: System notification emails show as Sent
entries.summary: emails such as a review assignment are recorded in History as **Sent** once they leave Sessionboard, including the from-address, instead of staying on **No delivery data**. Older messages that were never recorded this way still show **No delivery data**.
